records.title: RA-SOD: Reliability-Aware RGB-T Salient Object Detection under Modality Degradation
records.reason: The abstract concerns RGB-thermal salient-object detection under sensor degradation, with no language-model or serving contribution.

records.title: Breaking the Central Bias: Spatially Partitioned Experts for Coordinate-Based Neuroevolution
records.reason: The paper applies spatially partitioned experts to coordinate-based neuroevolution, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Safe to Resume? Breaking Execution Continuity of Agent Execution via Rollback
records.reason: The work models execution state across frameworks, tools, workspaces, and services and analyzes security violations caused by partial checkpoint/rollback boundaries. LangGraph/CrewAI examples include LLM calls but the contribution is recovery security; tests expose violations rather than measure inference/serving performance. The authors explicitly limit conclusions to rollback-induced security hazards, so no in-scope inference optimization is established.

records.title: Certified Split Windows for Parallel Lexing: Recovering Boundaries Where No Byte Certifies
records.reason: The abstract concerns certified split points for parallel lexing; no LLM inference/serving workload is described.

records.title: Business Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents in a Realistic Marketplace
records.reason: Business Arena is an environment for cross-border business decision-making and scores marketplace outcomes across frontier models. Ablations test policy mechanisms such as demand inference, portfolio choice, pricing, and customer service. The paper states it abstracts production systems and does not evaluate updating live storefronts or operating real interfaces. It is a task benchmark, not an agent sandbox/recovery or LLM inference-serving method.
